Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning notification for the pesticide ingredient clopyralid.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the pesticide ingredient clopyralid; and addinga new section to chapter 70.95 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.95 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a person supplies materials to a facility or program and theperson knows the facility or program is using the type of materialssupplied for composting, the person must disclose to the facility orprogram that the property on which the materials were grown had beentreated with a product containing the pesticide ingredient clopyralidif the property had been treated with such a product within theprevious two years.
